title: Fact or Guesswork? Evaluating Large Language Models' Medical Knowledge with Structured One-Hop Judgments
authors: Jiaxi Li; Yiwei Wang; Kai Zhang; Yujun Cai; Bryan Hooi; Nanyun Peng; Kai-Wei Chang; Jin Lu
why_relevant: Introduces a medical factuality benchmark showing LLM miscalibration and uses RAG as a mitigation, touching on calibration and uncertainty themes.
why_not_or_caveat: Focus is on probing parametric medical knowledge, not robustness of RAG under unreliable evidence; RAG is only a brief mitigation experiment.
